minimalIntegrationChanges.change: Add a fail-closed actual-execution gate: verify_summary(summary,3,3), exactly the three expected Passed leaf identities, no additional/duplicate/failed/skipped/expected-failure leaves, no parameter children, and wrapper exit status 0. Count-only verification is insufficient. Bind current source/overlays/environment and hashes to the raw xcresult summary/tree/log and comparison report.

Invoke the frozen comparator with mandatory --log <actual new-group -l log> and --output <fresh comparison.json>. Require a new parseable report with schemaVersion=1, observationLogProvided=true, fixtureContractsValidated=true, observationCollectionComplete=true and the exact matrix counts. Cross-check its log SHA256 and fixture/helper/observer hashes. Refuse an existing output/result bundle to prevent accepting a prior run.

executionGate.treeAdapter: Reuse the local-product exact identity walker pattern; allow only its known optional yuedu appTests/ prefix. New unparameterized methods must have no Arguments children. Preserve actual SDK tests-tree evidence; never infer identity from a synthetic fixture or summary count alone.

collectionGate.exactStages: Direct original route: decoded-rule only. Each other original route: imported, edited, export-reloaded. Each unknown route: imported, edited, export-reloaded, stored-reloaded. Exact identity/route/stage validation already exists in the frozen comparator.
collectionGate.logSource: scripts/xctest.sh redirects actual xcodebuild stdout/stderr to its -l file. The outer reader-smoke.log tee receives wrapper summaries, not the complete SOURCE_RULE_DEFAULTS_SWIFT rows. Feed the dedicated raw -l log to the comparator. Existing reader-stage capture uses the same approach.
collectionGate.missingPrintFallback: If the real SDK does not forward these print rows into xcodebuild output, treat that run as incomplete. Export the actual test console/stdout from that same xcresult using supported xcresulttool output and bind that raw input; do not synthesize rows, fall back to fixture-only mode, or accept an empty log.

statusSeparation.fixtureOnlyIsNotObservation: Without --log the frozen CLI intentionally returns 0 for fixture validation and emits observationLogProvided=false with no selectedContractsMatch. The new integration gate must reject this as execution/observation evidence.
statusSeparation.exitOneIsAmbiguous: A complete comparison with actual differences writes a fresh report then exits 1. Malformed/incomplete input also exits nonzero, often without a report. Preserve exit status/stdout/stderr; require complete fresh report and exact matrix plus passing actual XCTest before classifying observed-differences. Never blanket-ignore exit 1.
statusSeparation.observerAcceptance: Collection status may be complete while selectedContractsMatch=false. Use an explicit observed-differences status with compatibilityAccepted=false; do not label it parity passed, skip, KnownIssue or expected failure. Any structural/test/provenance failure must fail the collection gate. If selected compatibility is an acceptance criterion, propagate selectedContractsMatch=false as a failed criterion rather than weakening it.
statusSeparation.representationBoundary: Only five selected original getter/default-Gson fields and 13 project unknown-preservation cases are compared. serializeNulls remains an explicit diagnostic variant. Nullable/empty callback runtime eligibility is separate from wire retention. Full source-schema compatibility remains false.

sourceAndEnvironmentBinding: Reuse same-run overlays.json/source SHA, build-settings.json, xcode-version and reader-stage-environment.json inputs. Keep actual Debug Swift language/concurrency settings, SDK, Simulator runtime build/destination and source hashes; verify current observer/comparator/13-case fixture and four pinned original fixtures match the reviewed committed checkpoint. The comparator supplied-text provenance flags alone do not attest compilation or iOS execution.

riskReview.assessment: No definite blocker from source inspection: the suite is serialized, uses existing internal Codable types through @testable import, and calls unannotated static parseSources/writeLibrary plus importEditableJSON/importParse. It does not touch BookSourceStore.shared, GlobalSettings or UIKit. Private helper types are used only inside nonparameterized test methods. Actual app Swift5 and approachable-concurrency test-target macro/type checking are still unperformed; grammar success is not SDK compilation.

Tests/iOS is an existing PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup associated with yuedu appTests; the new Swift file should join that target without a pbxproj edit. Require actual three identities in xcresult to prove inclusion; source presence is insufficient.

Four parents from Tests/iOS/yuedu appTests/<file>.swift reach repository root. This relies on #filePath resolving to the same checked-out path still readable by the Simulator process, as existing host-file fixtures do; add a pre-Xcode fixture readability/hash check and let thrown Swift loads fail. It is not a device/bundle resource design and must not be accepted as physical-device execution. No fabricated fallback path.

Inputs are public pinned fixtures or owned .invalid sources; unknown storage uses a uniquely owned temporary directory with deferred cleanup. No private source files or network fixture server is required.

nextAction: Root can implement these minimal gates in one future consolidated source-only batch after accepting the frozen patch; this read-only review neither schedules nor triggers that run.
